notes.title: Our Demo is Live! 🎮 Trading Kingdom at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
The time has come to step into the medieval world! Join the exciting world of Trading Kingdom and begin your journey to transform your village into a thriving trade hub. 🌍💰 Compete with rival merchants, engage in battles, and expand your trade routes.

Coming Soon to the Demo
Enhanced Map System: You’ll be able to use a more detailed and interactive map.
Character Faces in Motion: NPCs will have facial animations, adding more depth to the story.
Sea Trading: Not just land, but you’ll be able to trade across the seas as well.
Expanded Marketplace: More areas and products will be available to enhance your trade.
Add the game to your wishlist and get ready for the grand adventure! 🏰

notes.title: Trading Kingdom is Coming to Steam Next Fest! 🎉 Demo Launching on October 14th!
notes.content:
Trading Kingdom is Coming to Steam Next Fest! 🌍⚔️ | Demo Available on October 14th!

Get ready for an exciting journey! 🎮 The countdown has begun for the grand debut of Trading Kingdom. We invite you to the medieval world with our demo, launching during Steam Next Fest on October 14th! 🌟

What Can You Do in the Demo?

🌍 Explore an Open World: Roam freely through a vast world filled with rich details. Start from your own village and discover the historic and captivating lands of Venice.

⚔️ Engage in Land and Naval Battles: Enter strategic battles with barbarians and rival merchants! Protect your caravans on land and clash with enemy ships on the seas.

💰 Trade and Compete: Manage your goods wisely, explore the markets, and engage in fierce competition with rival merchants. Take steps towards becoming the most respected trader in Europe.

🏞️ Hunt and Fish: Use the resources nature provides to survive. Hunt for your own food, fish, and strengthen your character.

🏘️ Develop Your Village: Turn your small village into a powerful trading hub by constructing buildings, gathering resources, and expanding your territory.

You won’t want to miss this exciting adventure! Experience the freedom offered in the world of Trading Kingdom and start laying the foundation of your future kingdom. 🏰

📅 Our demo will be available during Steam Next Fest on October 14th. Until then, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!

A grand adventure awaits you. 🌟
